text: 黑鲸实验室是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的黑鲸与夕小瑶风格界面皮肤。它通过 DSH Web 客户端插件加载，在主画布铺设主题背景，并加入品牌标识和专注模式按钮。皮肤为侧栏、输入卡、菜单及弹窗提供深色承载样式，还会观察界面控件的颜色，在浅底浅字时自动标记以调整对比度。用户可一键压暗画布，便于阅读长对话、代码和日志；卸载时会恢复标题、背景和注入的界面元素。适合希望个性化 DSH Web 外观的用户，需要可运行的 DSH Web profile 与 Node.js 24 环境。

Black Whale Lab skins the DeepSeek Harness Web client with themed artwork, dark surfaces and branding. It adds focus mode to dim the canvas for reading chats and code, and adjusts contrast on light controls. Unloading restores the title and backdrop. Requires a DSH Web profile and Node.js 24.

黑鲸实验室的功能「背景与主题」：为 DSH Web 主画布设置黑鲸实验室背景和深色主题配色，并让品牌背景透过嵌套画布显示。插件加载后自动应用。
黑鲸实验室的功能「专注模式」：通过页面右上角的专注模式按钮压暗画布；再次点击退出，并同步更新按钮状态。
黑鲸实验室的功能「控件对比度」：监测界面中新出现或样式变化的控件，在浅色背景与浅色文字组合时添加标记供皮肤样式修正。
黑鲸实验室的功能「卸载回滚」：插件卸载时断开观察器、移除界面元素，并恢复标题、背景样式和皮肤状态。
黑鲸实验室需要 Node.js 24 或更新版本；package.json 声明 engines.node 为 >=24。安装还要求可运行的 DSH Web profile。

@xiaoyao-ai/dsh-client-ui-skin-black-whale README · 它不是一张盖在界面上的壁纸：Black Whale Lab 是一个真实的 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端插件。它通过 DSH 的 profile 与 Cordis 插件加载器进入官方 Web 应用，保留原生会话、模型、工具、沙箱、权限和设置能力，只接管浏览器表现层。

- **背景透传**：处理 DSH 嵌套的两层基础画布，让鲸鱼与小瑶真正进入主工作区。
- **局部承载**：侧栏、输入卡、菜单和弹窗仍保持可靠底色，文字不会落进复杂背景。
- **自动对比度保护**：运行时识别“浅底＋浅字”控件并自动切换深色文字，不依赖易变化的 CSS 哈希类名。
- **专注模式**：右上角一键压暗画布，适合长对话、代码和日志阅读。
- **完整回滚**：卸载时恢复标题、背景、DOM 与样式作用域，不污染 Harness 本身。
- **本地优先**：不读取会话，不发送提示词，不调用模型，不上传任何数据。

@xiaoyao-ai/dsh-client-ui-skin-black-whale README · What it does：Black Whale Lab is a real DSH Web client plugin, not a screenshot or a replacement frontend. It keeps the official sessions, models, tools, sandbox, permissions and settings stack intact while changing only the browser presentation layer.

@xiaoyao-ai/dsh-client-ui-skin-black-whale README · What it does：- Passes the whale and Xiaoyao artwork through DSH's nested base canvases.
- Keeps the sidebar, composer, menus and dialogs readable with local surfaces.
- Repairs light-background/light-text controls through a class-name-independent runtime contrast guard.
- Adds a reversible focus mode for long-form reading and coding.
- Restores the original title, background and injected DOM on unload.
- Makes no network requests and never reads sessions, credentials or prompts.

@xiaoyao-ai/dsh-client-ui-skin-black-whale README · Install：Tested with DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` on Node.js 24.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add \
  https://github.com/147228/dsh-black-whale/releases/download/v0.1.3/xiaoyao-ai-dsh-client-ui-skin-black-whale-0.1.3.tgz
```

Or install the pinned Git tag:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:147228/dsh-black-whale#v0.1.3
```

Restart DSH Web after installation:

```sh
dsh web
```

@xiaoyao-ai/dsh-client-ui-skin-black-whale README · Install：Only one global DSH skin should be enabled at a time. Remove an existing global skin before installing Black Whale Lab.

Verify the bundle layer:

```sh
dsh web --dump-config | grep -n "ui-skin-black-whale"
```

Uninstall:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @xiaoyao-ai/dsh-client-ui-skin-black-whale
```

See [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) for troubleshooting.

@xiaoyao-ai/dsh-client-ui-skin-black-whale README · Architecture：The package contributes `ui-skin-black-whale` through `cordis.patch.yml`. Its Host entry is deliberately empty. The browser entry scopes all CSS under `body[data-dsh-black-whale]`, embeds artwork as data URIs, and adds only reversible presentation behavior. The official DSH backend remains the sole owner of sessions, models and tools.
